create_optimizer_model: create an OptimizerModel instance with MLP or RNN architecture for learning regret minimizer update rules
initialize_optimizer_model: initialize the OptimizerModel with optax Adam optimizer and neural network parameters
build_rnn_model: build an RNN model with configurable LSTM layers and MLP head using Haiku RNNCore
create_mlp_forward_fn: create a Haiku-transformed MLP forward function with configurable hidden layer sizes and ReLU activation
create_lr_scheduler: create an optax polynomial learning rate scheduler that decays from an initial value to 0.0001 over 100 steps
